requiredFindings.claim: RSS is the high-water mark of the concurrent process tree's summed RSS, not a sum of separate peaks (AQC:142-146).
requiredFindings.evidence: docs/coop/completion/analysis-quality-completion.v2.md:142-145 states a high-water resident sum over the supervised process tree and does not exclude a sum of per-process peaks. docs/coop/completion/language-quality-matrix.completed.v2.json:925 reports both the maximum observed simultaneous sum and the sum of individual high-water counters, and uses the larger as the conservative budget value.
requiredFindings.fix: State both quantities. If product cells follow the preview method, the budget value is the larger of the concurrent summed high-water and the sum of per-process high-water counters. If product cells use only the concurrent sum, record that as a new measurement choice and do not attribute the exclusion to AQC:142-146.

requiredFindings.claim: Facts, scopes and Coverage bind their snapshot and Plan (IE:177-182). Full replay of an old Run is not evidence for a new snapshot (IE:1586-1592). Paired full-versus-incremental sequences, including source edits, must give canonically equal facts, Coverage and replay outcomes.
requiredFindings.evidence: identity-and-evidence.md:177-182 is the domain-table header through plan2. scope2 at line 183 binds the snapshot, not the Plan. fact2 at line 184 binds the snapshot, not the Plan. coverage2 at line 185 binds the scope, not the Plan. view2 at line 186 binds the Plan with scopes, facts and Coverage. Lines 1586-1592 require a new Plan and Run for a policy or waiver change and require complete replay before cache admission against an authoritative Run. The new-source sentence is lines 1605-1606 and says a new Plan/Run, not that an old Run's replay is evidence for a new snapshot. A source edit therefore mints a new snapshot, and fact2 includes that snapshot, so the fact identities differ. PLAN.md:300 already says IDs need not match across Plans. The cache-hit half of INC-1 matches identity-and-evidence.md:1615-1626, and INC-2 matches reconstruction before sealing at lines 1580-1584.
requiredFindings.fix: Cite IE:183-185 and say scope and fact bind the snapshot, and Coverage binds the scope. Point the new-source sentence at IE:1605-1606. Keep the cache-hit rule. Make INC-4 compare semantic payloads and correspondence, and exclude fact2, coverage2 and Run identities that contain the snapshot or the Plan.

nonBlockingObservations.observation: SMAP:54 is FW-01 zero-config/recommend. SMAP:67 is FW-14, the real-configuration corpus. Neither line names a workspace assembled from separate repositories. D15 remains the owner's decision, and §11 already allows a SMAP or discovery successor if needed.

NE:1233-1237 is the mixed-native-partial outcome: TypeScript-scoped predicates evaluate and repository-scoped semantic predicates are indeterminate. Section 4.2 cites it that way. It is not a general report of how far unaffected units progressed under missing input, stale output or a broken build.

IE:1804-1806 lists independent replay across machines as one pre-shipping acceptance item. It does not define canonical equality under varied traversal order. PLAN.md:300 is the plan's comparison rule, including the ID exception INC-4 needs.
NE:1276 is the rust-v2 resolved-inputs rule that any field change changes PlanId. TypeScript binds PlanId through the context digest at NE:1576-1581.
The no-telemetry sentence is QG:271. CH13:82-84 forbids collecting private repositories and invents no numeric target.
